responsibility: Implements lowering of C23/C2x _BitInt operations from GIMPLE into forms the middle end and RTL expander can handle. It classifies bit-precise integers into small, middle, large, and huge categories using target hooks and mode limits, rewrites middle-width operations through ordinary INTEGER_TYPE casts, expands larger operations into limb-based straight-line code or loops, repairs SSA/CFG details such as PHIs, returns_twice arguments, and edge insertions, and defines both the normal and fallback O0 lowering passes that guarantee PROP_gimple_lbitint before expansion.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation file for the _BitInt lowering pair: it contains the actual lowering algorithms and registers the lowering passes (including the normal and O0 fallback passes), whereas gcc/gimple-lower-bitint.h only exposes the small cross-file helper declaration build_bitint_stmt_ssa_conflicts.
